openapi-docs-generator v0.1.0

- Initial release providing workflows, checklists, and decision support for generating, improving, and validating OpenAPI/Swagger documentation for REST APIs.
- Offers clear, actionable steps and verification notes tailored for backend and platform teams.
- Focuses on CPU-safe, local hardware-friendly solutions — no reliance on cloud or large models.
- Triggers on keywords related to API documentation needs and developer experience.
- Outputs include tailored responses, reusable workflows, validation notes, and clear next-step recommendations.
